product_entry: config.yml + kubecli setup longhorn-v2-gate 09, with runner-owned UID-scoped fault injection and cleanup
root_cause: The qualification requires an empty business baseline; it cannot be reused to recover a fault journal left after an uncertain native recovery. Recovery must enter its guarded journal before the empty-business prerequisite.
assertions: The cleanup-only shell branch enters guarded recovery without the qualification empty-business precheck.
Recovery refuses foreign parent/Pod and unknown outcomes, preserving the journal and preventing business deletion.
Post-recovery cleanup must pass empty-business, original disk and core/relay checks. Failure blocks both terminal success and scoped-clean markers.
Cleanup never invokes business or its result verifier and cannot emit LONGHORN_V2_REPLICA_IM_LOSS_QUALIFICATION_PASS.
Expected-failure CLI diagnostics remain inside a private 0600 local test fixture.
fixture_boundary: Local fake API/relay/CLI under TemporaryDirectory; no SSH or cluster mutation. Real result verifier executes via the CLI.
cleanup_scope: All local fixtures and expected-failure private diagnostics; production diagnostic retention is unchanged.
boundary: No live cleanup, fault qualification, complete LONGHORN-50 or delivery PASS.
